---
name: Bug report
about: Report a reproducible compatibility or behavior problem
title: ''
labels: bug
assignees: ''
---

**Version and environment**
Package version, Python/OS version, TV model and app version (when relevant).

**Steps to reproduce**
Include the exact command/tool and capture policy, with private values removed.

**Expected and actual behavior**
Distinguish command acknowledgement, native state and visually inspected outcome.

**Sanitized error text**
Do not include pairing keys, MACs, IP inventory, account names or personal captures.
For vulnerabilities, use the private reporting route in SECURITY.md instead.
